# Service image assets

Place new or replacement service images in this folder so they are available at
`/assets/service-images/<filename>` on the website. Keep the original filenames
when replacing an existing image, and update the service's source reference in
the site data when introducing a new filename.

| Image | Feature |
| --- | --- |
| `wallet-control.png` | Wallet control card |
| `bill-receipt.png` | Recharge and bill payment card |
